title: How technology loses out in companies, countries & continents and what to do about it
summary: A conference presentation by Bert Hubert on how companies lose their technological edge and become outsourcing hubs. It argues the same dynamic applies to whole countries and continents, and ends with suggestions for reversing it.
why: HN points to it as a sharper explanation of why outsourcing and specialization erode deep expertise, in threads on Intel, Boeing and software decline.

quote.text: this excellent video talks about the problems with outsourcing everything
